comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Billing UI pulls raw seats_remaining from /billing/usage; API will clamp and add seats_overage in the same payload.

content.text: Billing UI pulls raw seats_remaining from /billing/usage; API will clamp and add seats_overage in the same payload.

After downgrading a workspace plan (e.g. Business 25 seats to Team 10 seats) while 14 seats are still assigned, the Billing usage meter shows -4 seats remaining instead of 0 remaining and 4 over limit.

Remaining seats should floor at zero with a separate overage indicator when active members exceed the new plan cap. Negative remaining confuses admins into thinking the meter is broken and blocks the correct upgrade CTA copy.

Meter computes plan.seats - members.active without clamping; the downgrade webhook updates plan.seats before seat reclamation finishes. Display should use Math.max(0, plan.seats - members.active) and surface overBy when negative.
